text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Check it out, check it out! Our 
masterpiece, the ultimate birthday present 
presented by us!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Rights to Host the Chan-Heli & 
Pama-chin☆Festival" ...Fufu, what in the 
world is this?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's exactly what the name says☆ A ticket 
that gives ya the right to throw a 
hype-as-heck festival anytime, anywhere, 
as many times as ya want♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you call on us, to hype the whole 
place up! Helios and I will come rushing 
right over~, get it?♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yep! We'll carry the DJ set, stereo, disco 
ball, and even the sparkly tape bazookas 
over~★

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, anytime, anywhere? Are you seriously 
telling the truth?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course♪ A gal never goes back on her 
word!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally!☆ Whether it's a bummer night! Or 
a mega-downer morning! I'll seriously 
swoop in whenever, wherever~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Morning or night, huh, that's 
insane. Well then, when should I call you 
over...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I've got a job coming up where I can't 
oversleep no matter what, but 
Bamboo-senpai will be away on an away 
match, so I have to wake up all on my 
own...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, a wake-up prank festival? Seriously?
